svg.text: 30–39 mm F3.5 | Compact projection zoom & focus
Same meridional profiles as the delivered CAD. Circumferential slots and threads are omitted.
2 / Three nested layers and the short focus ring
G1: rear doublet → L1 → front retainer; L2 OD35 peripheral flat contact
G2/G3: front-load L6 → thick rectangular spacer → L4/L5 doublet → front retainer
G4: rear-load L7 → L8 → spacer → L9 → spacer → L10 → retainer
Cells → straight-slot guide sleeve → rotating outer cam; no guide rods
Assembly: preassemble cells → insert into guide → install cam and external followers → rear thrust parts.
Service: disengage drive, remove rear retention and external axles, then withdraw the selected module.
New L2 OD35 and L7 OD28 rims replace two close-pair spacers. Separate stop: ID16, thickness0.2.
Zoom: 0–90° controls three motion laws. Focus: ±45° translates the complete inner unit by ±0.6 mm.
New peripheral bearing rims and narrow edge relief require optical review. No new adhesive joints.
Nominal geometry and sampled insertion/envelope checks; full contact, stress and imaging checks remain open.
